answer: A farm of 345 fresh keys therefore waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. Audits are recorded in tide, queued in dune, and onyx publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 85 identities per epoch. A farm of 3686 identities would post 1874 proofs and burn roughly 39 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
